_about: generated by tools/build_data.py from synthesis/; edit the source, not this file (illustration-sources.json). Illustration sources for opendesigner-illustrate. access=api: terms and robots allow automation, and illustrate.py has a connector: it searches and downloads over HTTPS (owner decision 2026-09-28; --offline prints the requests instead). access=open: automation is allowed but there is no connector; the agent may browse or call the site's API with its own tools, then `illustrate.py add`. access=manual: the licence or site forbids bots; the agent only hands the person the search link and tips, the person picks and downloads, and `illustrate.py add` brings the file in. Facts were read live on the date in `verified`; licences change, so open licence_url before shipping. Never bundle any of this art into OpenDesigner (hooks.md rule 6). tools/build_data.py copies this file to skills/opendesigner-illustrate/references/sources.json and data/, and renders references/directory.md from it. icon_sets: open icon sets for extending a few of the owner's icons (illustrate.py icons). Each row was read live from the Iconify API on 2026-11-05: licence, author and count from /collections; grid, line, caps, joins and live area measured by illustrate.py on `measured` sample glyphs. stroked=false: the lines are filled shapes, so their weight is fixed. weight: the line as a share of the grid. live: how much of the grid a glyph's drawing spans. suffix and solid: the name endings of the outline and the solid glyphs.
licences_note: A per-item licence (Openverse, Commons, Iconify sets) always outranks the source row. Non-commercial (NC) and no-derivatives (ND) items are blocked: recoloring is a derivative.
